fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'NB International Pro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary canvas, page background, base borders — the absolute ground zero of the visual system

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Card and elevated surface background, subtle border tint — the first lift off pure black

palette.name: Tar
palette.role: Deep surface fill for nested elements, icon containers — sits between canvas and card

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Light neutral action fill for buttons on dark surfaces.

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted body text, secondary headings, low-emphasis borders — warm mid-gray companion to Bone

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Tertiary borders, disabled states, link underlines in rest position — the lowest visible neutral

palette.name: Pearl
palette.role: Cool-toned secondary text, icon fills on hover, light surface highlights

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Supporting text and icon borders, mid-weight border emphasis

palette.name: Chalk
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color
